description: This file implements a generic Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) processor with various size-specific and optimized algorithms, including templates for different sizes and SIMD optimizations. It defines classes for different DFT sizes and a main implementation class that selects the appropriate algorithm based on configuration.

classes.name: generic_dft_dit
classes.description: Template class implementing various sizes of Decimation-In-Time (DIT) FFT algorithms, including arbitrary sizes, powers of two, and specific small sizes like 3, 4, 9, and 3, 5, 6, 8, 12, 24, etc.

classes.name: dft_processor_generic_impl
classes.description: Main class that manages the configuration and execution of the appropriate DFT algorithm based on input size and direction.

methods.name: dft_processor_generic_impl::run
methods.description: Executes the selected DFT algorithm on input data and returns the output span.
